senses.en: trying to catch or get someone or something
senses.pattern: be after sb / go after the thief / come after sb / be after a job
senses.example: The police are [[after]] a man who stole three bicycles from the school last night.
senses.example_zh: 警方正在追捕一名昨晚從學校偷走三輛腳踏車的男子。

senses.en: following the name or style of someone or something
senses.pattern: be named after sb / name A after B / model A after B
senses.example: The new library was named [[after]] a retired teacher who had donated all her savings to the school.
senses.example_zh: 新圖書館以一位把畢生積蓄捐給學校的退休教師命名。

gsat.sentence: Sullivan, while surveying a campground, felt that a cloud was coming [[after]] him, and tried all he could to run—but it got him anyway.

senses.en: to provide someone with weapons or something useful
senses.pattern: arm oneself with knowledge / be armed with facts / arm the soldiers
senses.example: Before the debate, the students [[armed]] themselves with facts and figures about plastic pollution.
senses.example_zh: 辯論前，學生們以塑膠污染的事實與數據武裝自己。
senses.note: 複數名詞 arms 指「武器」

senses.en: a section of a large organization
senses.pattern: the research arm / the sales arm of the company / the investment arm
senses.example: The charity's education [[arm]] runs free weekend classes for children in remote mountain villages.
senses.example_zh: 該慈善機構的教育部門為偏遠山村的孩童開設免費的週末課程。

gsat.sentence: Living in a highly competitive society, you definitely have to [[arm]] yourself with as much knowledge as possible.

senses.en: a large formal party with dancing
senses.pattern: a charity ball / a masked ball / attend a ball
senses.example: Every guest at the charity [[ball]] wore a formal gown or suit and danced until midnight.
senses.example_zh: 慈善舞會上的每位賓客都穿著正式禮服或西裝，一直跳舞到午夜。
senses.note: have a ball 指「玩得很開心」

senses.en: angry and unhappy because of unfair treatment
senses.pattern: feel bitter about sth / be bitter toward sb / grow bitter
senses.example: He still feels [[bitter]] about being blamed for a mistake that his teammate had made.
senses.example_zh: 隊友犯的錯卻怪到他頭上，他至今仍憤恨不平。
senses.note: a bitter dispute 指「激烈的爭執」

senses.en: extremely and unpleasantly cold
senses.pattern: bitter cold / a bitter wind / a bitter winter
senses.example: Hikers were warned to wear thick coats against the [[bitter]] wind on the mountain top.
senses.example_zh: 登山客被提醒要穿厚外套，以抵擋山頂刺骨的寒風。

senses.en: except; apart from
senses.pattern: everyone but me / nothing but / anything but / have no choice but to V
senses.example: Everyone in the class [[but]] Kevin handed in the science report on time.
senses.example_zh: 除了凱文以外，班上每個人都準時交了自然科報告。

senses.en: only; no more than
senses.pattern: be but a child / but a moment ago / to name but a few
senses.example: Life is [[but]] a short journey, so spend it with the people you love.
senses.example_zh: 人生只不過是一段短暫的旅程，所以要與你所愛的人共度。

senses.en: to be in charge of a meeting or committee
senses.pattern: chair a meeting / chair a committee / chair the discussion
senses.example: Professor Lin was invited to [[chair]] the committee that selects this year's scholarship winners.
senses.example_zh: 林教授受邀主持遴選今年獎學金得主的委員會。

senses.en: the person in charge of a meeting or committee
senses.pattern: the chair of the committee / be elected chair / address the chair
senses.example: As [[chair]] of the student council, Mia opens every meeting with a short report.
senses.example_zh: 身為學生會主席，米亞每次開會都先做簡短報告。

senses.en: to make something less clear or confuse someone's judgment
senses.pattern: cloud one's judgment / cloud the issue / cloud one's memory
senses.example: The passing years have [[clouded]] my grandfather's memory of the village where he grew up.
senses.example_zh: 歲月流逝，使祖父對他成長的那個村莊的記憶變得模糊。

senses.en: something that causes worry, sadness, or suspicion
senses.pattern: cast a cloud over sth / under a cloud / a cloud of suspicion
senses.example: The injury to the team's best player cast a [[cloud]] over the final game.
senses.example_zh: 隊上最佳球員受傷，讓決賽蒙上一層陰影。
senses.note: a cloud of dust 指「一團塵土」

senses.en: the parts or substances that something is made of
senses.pattern: chemical composition / the composition of the soil / household composition
senses.example: Scientists analyzed the chemical [[composition]] of the rock brought back from the moon.
senses.example_zh: 科學家分析了從月球帶回的岩石的化學成分。

senses.en: a piece of music or art that someone has created
senses.pattern: a musical composition / an original composition / perform a composition
senses.example: The young pianist performed one of her own [[compositions]] at the school concert.
senses.example_zh: 這位年輕鋼琴家在學校音樂會上演奏了一首自己創作的樂曲。

gsat.sentence: Of course, in determining overall standards of living of Americans, factors such as household [[composition]] and family size need also to be taken into consideration.

senses.en: a traditional or generally accepted way of doing something
senses.pattern: by convention / social conventions / follow convention / break with convention
senses.example: By [[convention]], the youngest member of the family pours tea for the elders first.
senses.example_zh: 依照慣例，家中最年幼的成員要先為長輩倒茶。

senses.en: a formal agreement between countries
senses.pattern: sign a convention / an international convention / a convention on human rights
senses.example: More than one hundred countries have signed the [[convention]] on protecting endangered wild animals.
senses.example_zh: 已有一百多個國家簽署了保護瀕危野生動物的公約。

gsat.sentence: From the late 1850s until his death in 1910, Winslow Homer produced a body of work distinguished by its thoughtful expression and its independence from artistic [[conventions]].
Generally there are two ways to name typhoons: the number-based [[convention]] and the list-based convention.

senses.en: made specially for one particular person or purpose
senses.pattern: custom furniture / a custom suit / custom-made shoes
senses.example: The carpenter built a [[custom]] desk to fit the narrow corner of my bedroom.
senses.example_zh: 木匠為我訂做了一張書桌，剛好放得進臥室的狹窄角落。

senses.en: the place where officials check goods entering a country
senses.pattern: go through customs / clear customs / a customs officer
senses.example: All passengers must go through [[customs]] and declare any food they are carrying.
senses.example_zh: 所有旅客都必須通過海關，並申報隨身攜帶的任何食物。

gsat.sentence: I work there at the [[customs]].

senses.en: to decide that something is not worth considering
senses.pattern: dismiss an idea / dismiss sth as nonsense / dismiss a suggestion
senses.example: My brother [[dismissed]] my suggestion with a wave of his hand and went on playing his game.
senses.example_zh: 哥哥揮了揮手，對我的建議不予理會，繼續玩他的遊戲。

senses.en: (of a judge) to officially end a court case
senses.pattern: dismiss a case / dismiss a charge / dismiss an appeal
senses.example: The judge [[dismissed]] the case because there was not enough evidence against the driver.
senses.example_zh: 由於對駕駛不利的證據不足，法官駁回了這起案件。

senses.en: to get something you deserve because of your actions
senses.pattern: earn respect / earn a reputation / earn sb's trust / earn praise
senses.example: Her honesty and hard work [[earned]] her the trust of everyone in the office.
senses.example_zh: 她的誠實與努力為她贏得了辦公室裡每個人的信任。

senses.en: (of money) to produce interest or profit
senses.pattern: earn interest / earn a profit / earn a good return
senses.example: Money kept in this savings account [[earns]] about two percent interest a year.
senses.example_zh: 存在這個儲蓄帳戶裡的錢，每年大約可生百分之二的利息。

gsat.sentence: Be modest and hard-working to [[earn]] respect from other people.

Zoe was rather healthy when she was found, and once under the care of the orphanage she was very happy, consuming six gallons of vitamin-rich milk a day and [[earning]] a reputation as a confident, naughty and mischievous youngster.

senses.en: to demand and get something, often by force
senses.pattern: exact a price / exact revenge on sb / exact a promise from sb
senses.example: The long drought [[exacted]] a heavy price from farmers, who lost most of their crops.
senses.example_zh: 長期乾旱迫使農民付出慘痛代價，他們損失了大部分的作物。

senses.en: to prefer or support one over others, sometimes unfairly
senses.pattern: favor A over B / favor a plan / favor one side
senses.example: A fair referee should never [[favor]] one team over the other during a game.
senses.example_zh: 公正的裁判在比賽中絕不該偏袒任何一隊。
senses.note: in favor of 表「贊成、支持」

senses.en: to give an advantage to someone or something
senses.pattern: favor the home team / conditions favor sth / be favored by the weather
senses.example: The strong wind [[favored]] the sailors heading south, pushing their boats along the coast.
senses.example_zh: 強風有利於往南航行的水手，推著他們的船沿海岸前進。

gsat.sentence: Korea and Japan [[favor]] animal names and China likes names of gods such as Longwang (dragon king) and Fengshen (god of the wind).
The clockwise design [[favored]] right-handed castle defenders.

senses.en: to understand an explanation, argument, or story
senses.pattern: follow an explanation / follow the plot / hard to follow / Do you follow me?
senses.example: The professor spoke so fast that few students could [[follow]] his explanation.
senses.example_zh: 教授講得太快，很少學生能聽懂他的解釋。

senses.en: to be the logical result of something
senses.pattern: it follows that… / it doesn't follow that… / follow from sth
senses.example: Just because a product is expensive, it does not [[follow]] that it is good.
senses.example_zh: 一項產品價格昂貴，並不能由此推知它的品質一定好。

senses.en: an army officer of very high rank
senses.pattern: a four-star general / a retired general / the general's orders
senses.example: The [[general]] ordered his troops to cross the river before sunrise.
senses.example_zh: 將軍命令他的部隊在日出前渡河。

senses.en: highest in rank; having overall responsibility
senses.pattern: general manager / secretary-general / attorney general
senses.example: As [[general]] manager, she is responsible for every department of the hotel.
senses.example_zh: 身為總經理，她要為飯店的每個部門負責。

gsat.sentence: Swiss [[generals]] decided to issue each soldier a standard knife to serve both as a screwdriver and a can opener.

senses.en: the skin of a large animal, used for leather
senses.pattern: animal hides / buffalo hide / hides and furs
senses.example: Early hunters used animal [[hides]] to make warm clothes and simple tents.
senses.example_zh: 早期的獵人用獸皮製作保暖的衣物和簡單的帳篷。

senses.en: a tool or device used for precise or scientific work
senses.pattern: a surgical instrument / a measuring instrument / scientific instruments
senses.example: Doctors use a special [[instrument]] to look inside a patient's ear.
senses.example_zh: 醫生使用一種特殊儀器來檢查病人的耳朵內部。

senses.en: something used to achieve a particular result
senses.pattern: an instrument of change / an instrument for peace / an instrument of control
senses.example: Education can be a powerful [[instrument]] for reducing poverty in developing countries.
senses.example_zh: 教育可以成為開發中國家減少貧窮的有力手段。

gsat.sentence: The [[instrument]] is used to measure how a person’s body reacts to questions.
A paperclip, made of steel wire bent into a hooped shape, is an [[instrument]] used to hold sheets of paper together.

senses.en: to introduce a new product or start an activity
senses.pattern: launch a product / launch a campaign / launch an attack / launch a website
senses.example: The company plans to [[launch]] its first electric scooter in Asia next spring.
senses.example_zh: 該公司計劃明年春天在亞洲推出第一款電動機車。

senses.en: the event of introducing a new product or plan
senses.pattern: a product launch / a book launch / the launch of a campaign
senses.example: Hundreds of reporters attended the [[launch]] of the new smartphone last Friday.
senses.example_zh: 上週五有數百名記者出席了這款新智慧型手機的發表會。

gsat.sentence: To begin with, these staircases were quite narrow, so attackers would have to ascend one at a time, making it impossible to [[launch]] a mass attack.
To promote the new product, the company offered some free samples before they officially [[launched]] it.

senses.en: to want something very much
senses.pattern: long for peace / long to see sb / long for sb to V
senses.example: After months at sea, the sailors [[longed]] for a hot meal and a warm bed.
senses.example_zh: 在海上待了幾個月後，水手們渴望一頓熱食和一張溫暖的床。

senses.en: a means of communicating or expressing something
senses.pattern: a medium of communication / a medium of instruction / through the medium of television
senses.example: For many teenagers, short videos have become the main [[medium]] for sharing ideas.
senses.example_zh: 對許多青少年來說，短影音已成為分享想法的主要媒介。
senses.note: 複數為 media 或 mediums

senses.en: the material or form an artist uses
senses.pattern: an artist's medium / work in different media / mixed media
senses.example: The artist's favorite [[medium]] is watercolor, though she sometimes works in clay.
senses.example_zh: 這位藝術家最喜歡的創作材料是水彩，不過她有時也用黏土創作。

senses.en: only just achieved or avoided
senses.pattern: a narrow escape / a narrow victory / a narrow defeat / by a narrow margin
senses.example: Our team won a [[narrow]] victory, scoring the final point in the last second.
senses.example_zh: 我們隊在最後一秒拿下最後一分，驚險獲勝。
senses.note: 副詞 narrowly 指「勉強地、差一點」

senses.en: to make or become smaller or more limited
senses.pattern: narrow the gap / narrow down the choices / narrow the search
senses.example: The government hopes the new policy will [[narrow]] the gap between rich and poor.
senses.example_zh: 政府希望新政策能縮小貧富差距。

senses.en: (of a planned event) cancelled
senses.pattern: the game is off / the deal is off / the wedding is off
senses.example: Because of the approaching typhoon, tomorrow's school sports day is [[off]].
senses.example_zh: 由於颱風逼近，明天的學校運動會取消了。

senses.en: not as good as usual; not quite right
senses.pattern: sth feels off / have an off day / sound a little off
senses.example: The singer's voice sounded a little [[off]] tonight, probably because she had a cold.
senses.example_zh: 這位歌手今晚的聲音聽起來有點不對勁，大概是因為她感冒了。
senses.note: 英式英語也指食物「變質的」

senses.en: great care or effort taken to do something
senses.pattern: take pains to V / be at pains to V / go to great pains
senses.example: The host took great [[pains]] to make every guest feel welcome at the party.
senses.example_zh: 主人煞費苦心，讓每位賓客在派對上都感到賓至如歸。

senses.en: to make someone feel sad or upset
senses.pattern: it pains me to V / it pains sb that… / be pained by sth
senses.example: It [[pains]] me to see so much good food thrown away every day.
senses.example_zh: 看到每天有這麼多好好的食物被丟掉，真使我痛心。

senses.en: to start a fight or argument on purpose
senses.pattern: pick a fight with sb / pick a quarrel / pick an argument
senses.example: He was in a bad mood and tried to [[pick]] a fight with his brother.
senses.example_zh: 他心情不好，還想故意跟弟弟挑起爭吵。

senses.en: to open a lock without a key
senses.pattern: pick a lock / pick the lock on a door
senses.example: The thief [[picked]] the lock on the back door and entered the house quietly.
senses.example_zh: 小偷撬開後門的鎖，悄悄進入屋內。

senses.en: completely sure that something is true
senses.pattern: be positive that… / be positive about sth / absolutely positive
senses.example: Are you [[positive]] that the meeting is on Friday? I thought it had been moved to Thursday.
senses.example_zh: 你確信會議是在星期五嗎？我以為已經改到星期四了。

senses.en: showing that a substance or disease is present
senses.pattern: test positive for sth / a positive result / a positive reading
senses.example: Two players tested [[positive]] for the flu and had to stay home for a week.
senses.example_zh: 兩名球員流感檢驗呈陽性，必須在家休息一週。

gsat.sentence: Can one of these energy drinks really cause someone to test [[positive]] on an ABT?
A “[[positive]]” test result, a result over the legal limit, allows the police to arrest the driver.

senses.en: to estimate a future amount from present information
senses.pattern: project sales / project that… / be projected to rise / projected growth
senses.example: Experts [[project]] that the city's population will double within the next twenty years.
senses.example_zh: 專家預估該市人口將在未來二十年內增加一倍。

senses.en: to make light or an image appear on a surface
senses.pattern: project an image onto a screen / project a film / project light
senses.example: The teacher [[projected]] the map onto the wall so that everyone could see it.
senses.example_zh: 老師把地圖投射在牆上，讓每個人都看得到。

senses.en: used to introduce a contrasting, more accurate idea
senses.pattern: not A; rather, B / not… but rather… / rather, it is…
senses.example: The trip was not a waste of time; [[rather]], it taught us how to work together.
senses.example_zh: 這趟旅行並非浪費時間；相反地，它教會了我們如何合作。

senses.en: used to correct or improve what was just said
senses.pattern: A, or rather B / or rather, I should say
senses.example: She arrived late last night, or [[rather]], early this morning at around two.
senses.example_zh: 她昨天深夜才到，更確切地說，是今天凌晨兩點左右。

gsat.sentence: [[Rather]] it is PBS, Public Broadcasting System, a non-profit public broadcasting TV service.

senses.en: a supply of something kept for future use
senses.pattern: oil reserves / fat reserves / keep sth in reserve / foreign exchange reserves
senses.example: The country keeps large [[reserves]] of oil in case of an emergency.
senses.example_zh: 該國保有大量的石油儲備，以備緊急之需。

senses.en: an area of land where wildlife is protected
senses.pattern: a nature reserve / a wildlife reserve / a forest reserve
senses.example: Visitors to the wildlife [[reserve]] are not allowed to feed the animals.
senses.example_zh: 野生動物保護區的遊客不得餵食動物。

gsat.sentence: The Japanese used their rubber [[reserves]] from the war to mass-produce the simplest Japanese footwear.
Sitting for too long slows down the body’s metabolism and the way enzymes break down our fat [[reserves]], raising both blood sugar levels and blood pressure.

senses.en: to dismiss someone from a job
senses.pattern: sack a worker / be sacked for being late / get the sack
senses.example: The coach was [[sacked]] after the team lost ten games in a row.
senses.example_zh: 球隊十連敗後，教練遭到解雇。
senses.note: 英式口語；get the sack 指「被解雇」

senses.en: to destroy and rob a captured town or city
senses.pattern: sack a city / sack the town / be sacked by invaders
senses.example: The invading army [[sacked]] the ancient city and carried away its treasures.
senses.example_zh: 入侵的軍隊洗劫了這座古城，並帶走城裡的寶物。

senses.en: carefully chosen; open only to a small special group
senses.pattern: a select group / a select few / a select club
senses.example: Only a [[select]] few students were invited to have lunch with the visiting scientist.
senses.example_zh: 只有少數精挑細選的學生受邀與來訪的科學家共進午餐。

senses.en: something showing that something exists or may happen
senses.pattern: a sign of aging / show signs of improvement / a sure sign that… / a warning sign
senses.example: Dark clouds in the west are usually a [[sign]] that rain is on the way.
senses.example_zh: 西邊的烏雲通常是快要下雨的徵兆。

senses.en: to communicate using sign language
senses.pattern: sign to sb / learn to sign / sign fluently
senses.example: The teacher [[signed]] to the deaf students while she explained the experiment aloud.
senses.example_zh: 老師一邊口頭講解實驗，一邊向聽障學生打手語。

gsat.sentence: In fact, there is a well-known Russian proverb that goes, “Smiling with no reason is a [[sign]] of stupidity.”
The males sniff it for longer duration and come back to the same spot more frequently, a clear [[sign]] that they are gathering information about mating opportunities from the poop.

senses.en: reliable; having a strong basis
senses.pattern: solid evidence / a solid foundation / a solid reason / solid support
senses.example: Three years of daily practice gave her a [[solid]] foundation in English grammar and writing.
senses.example_zh: 三年來每天練習，讓她在英文文法和寫作上打下紮實的基礎。

senses.en: continuous; without any break
senses.pattern: three solid hours / for a solid week / two hours solid
senses.example: It rained for three [[solid]] days, and the river flooded the nearby fields.
senses.example_zh: 雨整整下了三天，河水淹沒了附近的田地。

gsat.sentence: This story may sound highly credible, but there seems to be no [[solid]] evidence that it inspired the creation of the treats we know of today as fortune cookies.
This course will provide students with a [[solid]] foundation for research. It is highly recommended for those who plan to go to graduate school.

senses.en: to organize a public event or protest
senses.pattern: stage a protest / stage a strike / stage a demonstration
senses.example: Animal lovers [[staged]] a silent march through the city center to call for stricter laws against cruelty.
senses.example_zh: 愛護動物人士在市中心發動一場靜默遊行，呼籲制定更嚴格的反虐待動物法規。
senses.note: stage a comeback 指「東山再起」

senses.en: to put on a play or show for an audience
senses.pattern: stage a play / stage a musical / stage a concert
senses.example: The drama club will [[stage]] a Shakespeare comedy at the end of the semester.
senses.example_zh: 戲劇社將在學期末上演一齣莎士比亞喜劇。

senses.en: to come into someone's mind; to give an impression
senses.pattern: it strikes sb that… / strike sb as odd / be struck by sth
senses.example: What [[struck]] me most about the village was how friendly everyone was.
senses.example_zh: 這個村莊給我印象最深的，是每個人都非常友善。
senses.note: 過去式、過去分詞為 struck

senses.en: (of disaster or illness) to happen suddenly and harmfully
senses.pattern: disaster strikes / tragedy struck / when the earthquake struck
senses.example: When the earthquake [[struck]], most of the villagers were still asleep in their beds.
senses.example_zh: 地震侵襲時，大多數村民還在床上熟睡。

senses.en: a period of refusing to work as a protest
senses.pattern: go on strike / be on strike / a general strike
senses.example: Nurses at the hospital voted to go on [[strike]] unless more staff were hired by June.
senses.example_zh: 這家醫院的護理師投票決定，除非六月前增聘人手，否則就要罷工。

gsat.sentence: It can [[strike]] suddenly, progressing from a feeling of uneasiness to a cold sweat.
It suddenly [[struck]] me that I had to get to the airport to meet a friend.

senses.en: to spread quickly through a place
senses.pattern: sweep the country / sweep the nation / sweep through the city / sweep across Europe
senses.example: Wildfires [[swept]] the dry hillsides last summer, forcing thousands of residents to leave their homes.
senses.example_zh: 去年夏天野火席捲乾燥的山坡，迫使數千名居民撤離家園。
senses.note: 過去式、過去分詞為 swept

senses.en: to look quickly over a whole area
senses.pattern: sweep the room / sweep the horizon / sb's eyes sweep the crowd
senses.example: The lifeguard's eyes [[swept]] the beach for any swimmers who might be in trouble.
senses.example_zh: 救生員的目光掃視海灘，尋找任何可能遇上麻煩的泳客。

senses.en: a strong connection between people, groups, or countries
senses.pattern: close ties / family ties / strengthen ties with sb / cut ties
senses.example: Strong family [[ties]] kept the three brothers in touch even after they moved to different countries.
senses.example_zh: 緊密的家庭關係讓三兄弟即使移居不同國家，仍一直保持聯絡。

senses.en: a result in which both sides have equal scores
senses.pattern: end in a tie / a tie for first place / break a tie
senses.example: The final match ended in a [[tie]], so both teams shared the trophy.
senses.example_zh: 決賽以平手收場，因此兩隊共享獎盃。
senses.note: 動詞 tie 指「打成平手」

gsat.sentence: We are more than willing to strengthen our [[ties]] with those countries that are friendly to us.

senses.en: faithful and loyal to someone or something
senses.pattern: be true to one's word / stay true to oneself / remain true to one's beliefs
senses.example: She stayed [[true]] to her word and returned every dollar she had borrowed.
senses.example_zh: 她忠實信守諾言，把借來的每一塊錢都還清了。

senses.en: applying correctly to a person or situation
senses.pattern: hold true / be true of sb / the same is true for…
senses.example: Cats love to sleep in warm places, and the same is [[true]] of many dogs.
senses.example_zh: 貓喜歡睡在溫暖的地方，這一點也適用於許多狗。

gsat.sentence: But does this hold [[true]] across time and cultures?

senses.en: unwanted material left after something has been used
senses.pattern: household waste / industrial waste / nuclear waste / waste disposal
senses.example: The factory was fined for pouring chemical [[waste]] into the nearby river.
senses.example_zh: 這家工廠因為把化學廢棄物倒入附近河川而遭罰款。

senses.en: no longer needed; (of land) not used
senses.pattern: waste paper / waste water / waste land / a waste product
senses.example: The children turned a piece of [[waste]] ground behind the school into a vegetable garden.
senses.example_zh: 孩子們把學校後方一塊荒蕪的空地變成了菜園。

gsat.sentence: In addition, bottled water produces an incredible amount of solid [[waste]].
The cactus’s thick outer layer (i.e., husk), with all those spines, had always been viewed as a [[waste]] product until researchers developed a biogas generator to turn the husks into electricity.

senses.en: to treat or judge someone unfairly
senses.pattern: wrong sb / feel wronged / be deeply wronged
senses.example: She felt deeply [[wronged]] when her classmates accused her of cheating on the test.
senses.example_zh: 同學指控她考試作弊，讓她覺得深受冤枉。

senses.en: an unjust, dishonest, or immoral act
senses.pattern: right a wrong / do sb wrong / know right from wrong
senses.example: The king promised to right the [[wrongs]] that his soldiers had done to the villagers.
senses.example_zh: 國王承諾要彌補他的士兵對村民所做的不義之事。

gsat.sentence: Once the [[wrong]] was made right, the pole was taken down.
To teach children right from [[wrong]], some parents will reward their children when they behave well and punish them when they misbehave.

quiz.stem: Although several engineers had warned that the old bridge was unsafe, the mayor ______ their concerns as exaggerated and kept it open to traffic.
quiz.explain_zh: dismiss＝不予理會。市長認為工程師的擔憂言過其實，不予理會。

quiz.stem: The two cities have maintained close cultural ______ for decades, exchanging students and holding a joint music festival every summer.
quiz.explain_zh: tie＝關係、聯繫。兩座城市數十年來維持密切的文化關係。

quiz.stem: Mrs. Lin is ______ that she turned off the stove before leaving home, because she clearly remembers checking it twice.
quiz.explain_zh: positive＝確信的。林太太記得檢查過兩次，所以確信瓦斯爐已關。

quiz.stem: In the United States, it is a social ______ to tip waiters at least fifteen percent of the bill, although no law requires it.
quiz.explain_zh: convention＝慣例。給服務生小費是社會慣例，並非法律規定。

quiz.stem: Doctors are trained to stay calm in emergencies, because strong emotions can ______ their judgment and lead to serious mistakes.
quiz.explain_zh: cloud＝影響（判斷）。強烈的情緒會影響醫生的判斷而導致失誤。

quiz.stem: To protest against the plan to cut down the old trees, local residents ______ a peaceful demonstration in front of the city hall last Sunday.
quiz.explain_zh: stage＝發動、舉行（抗議）。居民在市政府前舉行和平示威。

quiz.stem: The train drivers' ______ over low pay has entered its second week, leaving commuters with no choice but to drive or take crowded buses.
quiz.explain_zh: strike＝罷工。火車司機因低薪罷工已進入第二週，通勤族只能開車或擠公車。

quiz.stem: The lawyer warned her client that without ______ evidence, such as photos or written records, the judge would be unlikely to believe his story.
quiz.explain_zh: solid＝可靠的。沒有照片或書面紀錄等可靠證據，法官不太會相信。

quiz.stem: Camels can go for weeks without food in the desert because they carry large fat ______ in their humps and slowly turn them into energy.
quiz.explain_zh: reserve＝儲備（量）。駱駝在駝峰儲存大量脂肪，可慢慢轉化為能量。

quiz.stem: A wave of excitement is ______ the country as the national badminton team advances to the final of the world championship.
quiz.explain_zh: sweep＝席捲。國家羽球隊打進世錦賽決賽，興奮的熱潮席捲全國。
